description: Remove AI slop from any voice-bearing prose — original posts, threads, articles, long-form, emails, docs, READMEs, marketing copy, bios, scripts. Use when drafting text meant to sound like a specific person or brand, when rewriting text that reads generic, corporate, or AI-generated, or when asked to humanize, de-slop, audit, or "make this sound like me / like us." Works in any agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, custom) — no tools required. NOT built for X/Twitter reply batches: those need target selection on top of this skill's gate, which is out of scope here.
